_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/sdk_coverage.py. Known, accepted gaps between the monarchmoney SDK and the tools this server exposes. New entries may not be added without a deliberate update; entries that no longer reproduce must be removed. Regenerate with: uv run python scripts/sdk_coverage.py --update-baseline. SDK 1.5.2 added seven methods, recorded here rather than wrapped. login_with_cookies and set_cookies are auth-layer, which this server owns through client.py/secure_session.py, so they stay unwrapped for the same reason login and interactive_login do. The other five are real capability this server does not yet expose: find_duplicate_transactions (read), reset_budget, update_flexible_budget, update_flex_rollover_settings, update_reoccuring and upload_receipt_to_inbox (writes). Exposing them is a deliberate piece of work — each write needs a safety tier, a pre-operation snapshot and a rollback plan to match the rest of the server, and reset_budget clears a user's planned amounts. They were not bundled into a dependency upgrade.
